rules: Why Mechanical 09:20 Straddles Fail Now ([wQoOutGqZKU]): 'Somebody started this 9:20 short straddle system... it caught like a forest fire and everyone ran algos. Nowadays markets move 300 points up and down every day so stop-losses are hit left, right, and center.'
Pre-Market Global & GIFT Nifty Gap Rule: If GIFT Nifty gaps >150–200 pts on US news, 70%–80% of the move is already priced in at 9:15 AM. Never chase the gap in the same direction at 9:15.
The 9:15 to 9:30 AM Settlement Rule: Never enter in the first 10–15 minutes while overnight writers are panic-covering. Wait until 09:25–09:45 AM for bid-ask spreads and IV to settle.

Open = High (O=H) & Open = Low (O=L): If Nifty opens and never ticks below its opening price for 15–30 minutes (Open = Low), Call writers are trapped and forced to cover (Bullish). If Open = High, Put writers are trapped (Bearish).

synthesized_playbook.title: 2. His 4 Core Option Selling Systems (Strangles, Straddles, Ratios & Low-VIX Calendars)
synthesized_playbook.summary: Extracted from 1,293 option-selling videos ([HbMgcDuWauk], [LR5d4HrNYwA], [3dXJjwUPsUg], [wQoOutGqZKU]): P R Sundar switches his selling structure based on India VIX and DTE rather than running one blind strategy.
rules: System A — Positional Weekly Short Strangle (Normal/High VIX > 13): Enter on Expiry afternoon or DTE ≤ 4 days. Sell OTM Call + OTM Put with matching premiums, hedged with far OTM ₹3–₹5 wings for SEBI margin reduction. Hold across the weekend to capture multi-day theta.

System B — Low-VIX ITM Put/Call Calendar Spread ([3dXJjwUPsUg]): Learned after his 2013 Taper Tantrum ₹1 Cr MTM shock (where Nifty closed flat but VIX spiked and blew up naked strangles). When India VIX is ultra-low (<12–13), NEVER sell naked strangles! Instead, sell a near-month slightly ITM option (e.g. 16,000 PE at ₹350) and buy a far-dated option at the same strike (₹580). Margin is only ~₹50k, VIX expansion helps your long leg, and near-month theta decays 2x faster.

System C — Zero-Debit Call/Put Ratio Spreads (1:2 or 1:3, [rrtQsbsLaqs] & [wQoOutGqZKU]): Buy 1 lot near-ATM option and Sell 2 or 3 lots further OTM option for zero net debit. If the market moves opposite to your view, loss is ZERO. If it moves moderately in your direction, you capture the big profit tent.
System D — Base Straddle + Intraday Adjustment ([LR5d4HrNYwA]): Call the initial entry the 'Base Trade' and keep 40% capital reserved strictly for intraday/positional adjustments.

synthesized_playbook.title: 4. The Complete Firefighting Manual — How He Saves Losing Trades (& The ₹1.32 Cr Warning!)
synthesized_playbook.summary: Mined from 1,102 videos including [m_KCy-IgRmU] (Infosys recovery) and [8jaj27q7bl4] (HDFC ₹1.32 Cr loss): How to adjust a tested leg step-by-step, and when firefighting becomes 'pouring petrol on the fire'.
rules: Rule 1 — Never Close the Tested Leg First in Panic ([m_KCy-IgRmU]): When market moves against your Short Call, book profit on the winning Short Put and sell a new higher-strike Put closer to Spot to collect fresh credit and shift your upper breakeven.

Rule 2 — Progressive Step-Up (Strangle → Straddle → Inversion): As the untested leg decays to ≤35%–50% of the tested leg, keep rolling the untested leg toward Spot until both legs meet (Straddle). In strong trends ([m_KCy-IgRmU]), he even sells additional Put lots at the new support level.

Rule 3 — THE ₹1.32 CRORE WARNING ('Pouring Petrol on the Fire', [8jaj27q7bl4]): In HDFC, after converting a losing Call into a 2400 Straddle, HDFC gapped up 15% to 2950 on merger news. He aggressively sold high-strike Puts (200–300 lots) to firefight — and then HDFC reversed straight back from 3000 to 2000, trapping both sides for a ₹1.32 Crore loss!

Rule 4 — The Anti-Whipsaw Guardrail: Never increase lot size wildly during firefighting, avoid single-stock options (stick to Nifty/BankNifty index options which cannot gap 15% on company merger news), and enforce a hard +44% leg SL or max 2 rolls per cycle so a V-reversal cannot trap you.
synthesized_playbook.when_to_use: On every positional or intraday strangle when one side is tested, strictly capped at 1–2 rolls.

synthesized_playbook.title: 5. His Extra 7% Guaranteed Collateral Secret & Position Sizing Rules
synthesized_playbook.summary: From [L8hCnPmd6-Q] (498k views), [MGJpA4iubI0], and [8jaj27q7bl4]: How institutional and HNI option sellers structure their capital so they earn two streams of income on the same rupee.
rules: The Double-Engine Collateral Pledging Secret ([L8hCnPmd6-Q]): Never keep 100% idle cash in your broker account. Invest in Debt ETFs / Bharat Bond / Liquid Bees / Sovereign Gold Bonds or Bluechip ETFs (earning 7%–10% safe annual yield), pledge them with the broker for 80%–90% F&O margin, and run Nifty Option Selling on top of that pledged margin.
Keep 35%–40% Free Margin for Adjustments: If you deploy 100% of your margin on Day 1, you are paralyzed the moment Nifty moves 200 points and cannot execute firefighting rolls.

Never Trade Stock Options Under ₹1 Crore Capital ([m_KCy-IgRmU]): Individual stocks have binary news risk, physical settlement margin traps ([i1J9oiyo3T8]), and illiquid strikes. Retail and mid-sized accounts should trade 100% NSE Index Options (NIFTY 50).
